rationale: Price is sitting 82.9% through today's range after an 8.53% gap-up, with the last five 1-minute candles showing choppy, directionless action between roughly $163.76 and $164.30 — no clear momentum in either direction. The 9-EMA ($164.38) is just above current price, suggesting mild short-term softness, but the spread between VWAP ($161.62) and price is wide enough that mean-reversion risk is elevated for a long while the high-volume gap-up context makes a short risky against residual buying pressure. With no news catalyst identified and an already negative P&L on the day, the risk/reward for either direction is insufficient to justify a trade.
